title: Differential review / patch diffing
steps: For source: `git diff base..head --stat` then read only hunks touching parsing, auth, crypto, allocation, or IPC.
Trace new/changed dataflow to a sink; check whether a check was added or removed.
For binaries: `radiff2 -C a b`, `diaphora`/`bindiff`, or Ghidra version tracking; focus on changed functions.
Write the vulnerability hypothesis as: input → changed path → missing check → impact.
falsifier: The diff is cosmetic/refactor only and no changed path reaches a security-relevant sink.
